context:
Goal: the drain lands only what is safe, then the plan starts.
Problem (rule): #1805 refuses 2 of every 3 ordinary messages unless its fix #1849 ships with it, and adding #1849 changes your named drain queue.
Based on (ruling): R23, your 19:23 CST "Named queue" ruling, which lists the only PRs the drain may land.
Based on (measured): #1805 alone refuses 136 of 204 messages. With #1849 it refuses 13 of 204 (6%). #1849 passed review round 3.
Departs from: the named queue on main's restart plan — adds #1849, and #1805 lands only together with it.
Meanwhile: #1805 waits. Triage keeps linting the other queued PRs, and the guard that stops a worktree switch while agents run (built on top of #1849) goes to the sort.

options.how: #1849 merges #1805's head, gets a fresh round 1, both are linted, and they go to the coordinator as one pair.
options.label: Add #1849 and ship the two as a pair (Recommended)
options.lose: One more PR, and one more review and lint pass first.

options.how: #1805 leaves the named queue; triage's sort places both in that stage.
options.label: Send both to the plan's later build stage
options.lose: The guard waits until the restart plan's third stage, when lanes build its listed fixes.

options.how: #1805 goes to the next batch as reviewed; #1849 follows later.
options.label: Ship #1805 alone
options.lose: About 2 of every 3 ordinary messages are refused until #1849 lands.

title: May #1849 join your named drain queue, so #1805 (the message-role guard) ships only together with its false-alarm fix?
why: Alone, #1805 would refuse about 2 of every 3 ordinary messages between sessions.
